# CalmPDF

> CalmPDF is a private, browser-based PDF toolkit. Tools run locally in JavaScript so
> files stay on the device and are never uploaded to CalmPDF servers.

## Core product positioning

- [Private PDF tools](https://calmpdf.com/tools): Free PDF workflows that run in-browser with no account required.
- [Edit PDF](https://calmpdf.com/edit-pdf): Add text, highlights, and annotations directly in your browser.
- [About CalmPDF](https://calmpdf.com/about): Product overview and feature direction.
- [Privacy](https://calmpdf.com/privacy): Privacy policy for browser-based PDF processing.

## Intent taxonomy: conversion workflows

- [PDF to Word](https://calmpdf.com/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF documents to editable Word files.
- [Word to PDF](https://calmpdf.com/word-to-pdf): Convert DOCX files into standard PDF format.
- [PDF to JPG](https://calmpdf.com/pdf-to-jpg): Export PDF pages as JPG images.
- [PDF to PNG](https://calmpdf.com/pdf-to-png): Export PDF pages as PNG images.

## Intent taxonomy: file size optimization

- [Compress PDF](https://calmpdf.com/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size for sharing and storage.
- [Compress PDF for Email](https://calmpdf.com/compress-pdf-for-email): Optimize PDFs for Gmail, Outlook, and attachment limits.
- [Compress PDF to 100KB](https://calmpdf.com/compress-pdf-to-100kb): Target very small PDFs for forms and portals.
- [Compress PDF to 200KB](https://calmpdf.com/compress-pdf-to-200kb): Target low-size uploads with readable quality.
- [Compress PDF to 500KB](https://calmpdf.com/compress-pdf-to-500kb): Balance quality and size for routine sharing.
- [Compress PDF to 1MB](https://calmpdf.com/compress-pdf-to-1mb): Keep larger PDFs within common submission limits.
- [How to Compress a PDF Without Losing Quality](https://calmpdf.com/how-to/compress-pdf-without-losing-quality): Practical guide for quality-aware compression.

## Intent taxonomy: document editing and annotation

- [Edit PDF](https://calmpdf.com/edit-pdf): Edit and annotate PDF pages online.
- [Rotate PDF](https://calmpdf.com/rotate-pdf): Rotate scanned or misoriented pages.
- [Reorder PDF Pages](https://calmpdf.com/reorder-pdf-pages): Rearrange page order before sharing or filing.
- [How to Add Text to a PDF](https://calmpdf.com/how-to/add-text-to-pdf): Add typed text to existing PDF pages.
- [How to Rotate a PDF](https://calmpdf.com/how-to/rotate-pdf): Step-by-step rotation workflow for single or multiple pages.
- [How to Edit a PDF for Free](https://calmpdf.com/how-to/edit-pdf-free): Compare free methods for browser and desktop editing.

## Intent taxonomy: extraction and organization

- [Merge PDF](https://calmpdf.com/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs into one document.
- [Split PDF](https://calmpdf.com/split-pdf): Split one PDF into page ranges or single-page files.
- [Extract PDF Pages](https://calmpdf.com/extract-pdf-pages): Pull selected pages into a new PDF.
- [How to Combine PDF Files](https://calmpdf.com/how-to/combine-pdf-files): General merge workflow for multi-file document sets.
- [How to Split a PDF into Multiple Files](https://calmpdf.com/how-to/split-pdf-into-multiple-files): Break large PDFs into separate deliverables.
- [How to Reorder PDF Pages Online](https://calmpdf.com/how-to/reorder-pdf-pages-online): Organize page sequence before export.
- [How to Merge PDF Files Free](https://calmpdf.com/how-to/merge-pdf-files-free): Compare free merging options.

## Intent taxonomy: privacy and security positioning

- [Private PDF tools](https://calmpdf.com/tools): Browser-only processing for users who avoid file uploads.
- [How to Edit a PDF for Free](https://calmpdf.com/how-to/edit-pdf-free): Includes options for editing without uploading sensitive documents.
- [How to Compress a PDF on Mac](https://calmpdf.com/how-to/compress-pdf-on-mac): Local and browser-based compression methods.
- [How to Compress a PDF on Windows](https://calmpdf.com/how-to/compress-pdf-on-windows): Windows-friendly compression methods including in-browser private workflows.

## Intent taxonomy: audience use cases

### Students

- [Compress PDF for Email](https://calmpdf.com/compress-pdf-for-email): Submit assignments under strict attachment limits.
- [Compress PDF to 500KB](https://calmpdf.com/compress-pdf-to-500kb): Meet LMS and scholarship portal file caps.
- [Split PDF](https://calmpdf.com/split-pdf): Submit only required pages from long lecture packets.

### Business

- [Merge PDF](https://calmpdf.com/merge-pdf): Combine invoices, proposals, and reports into one file.
- [Reorder PDF Pages](https://calmpdf.com/reorder-pdf-pages): Fix page order in client-facing deliverables.
- [Compress PDF](https://calmpdf.com/compress-pdf): Shrink large PDFs for faster internal and external sharing.

### Government and compliance

- [Compress PDF to 1MB](https://calmpdf.com/compress-pdf-to-1mb): Fit common upload limits on public portals.
- [Extract PDF Pages](https://calmpdf.com/extract-pdf-pages): Isolate required pages for records requests and filings.
- [Rotate PDF](https://calmpdf.com/rotate-pdf): Correct scanned forms before submission.
